notes: Two-color, single-family system. Screenshot is ground truth: dominant body is ~22px monospace (1.375rem) at weight 700 — NOT the 16px sans, which the raw profile counts (15 nodes) but is only fine-print/fallback. Body line-height in raw is 18px against 22px text (~0.82) — an unusually tight, printed-receipt setting; kept as leading[0]. Display sizes 48/60px map to the wordmark and 'THANK YOU' footer only. No hue, radius, or shadow anywhere (rounded to 0/none). 'muted' and 'accent' collapse to #000 because the page has no intermediate tones; surface == bg (no cards). Inverted roles (white-on-black) appear only in the wordmark bar and footer. Motion: the static read is calm but two ambient layers run hot — durations are 1000ms (the `displace` liquid-wordmark warp via SVG feDisplacementMap `#displacementFilter3`) and 500ms, on bare `ease` (no cubic-bezier, no stagger). The `%`-glyph margin field is a pointer-reactive canvas/DOM particle layer (9 mousemove, 2 canvas, ~235 rAF), and a `position:fixed` div is the still backdrop the receipt scrolls over. No scroll choreography on the content column itself; the lone IntersectionObserver observes 0 targets. `prefers-reduced-motion` is NOT respected (prmRules:0) — recorded as reduced_motion:not-respected. Pure #000/#fff per capture; a production adaptation could soften fg to var(--color-fg) #0b0d12 to reduce halation with no visual concept loss.
